description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.note: Signals generated and posted only within this GMT window on US trading days.

macro_kill_switches.note: VIX above this value halts all signals for the session.

vix_thresholds.note: VIX 20-25 raises confluence bar to 5/6. VIX 25-30 adds position-sizing note. VIX >30 is the kill switch.

confluence.note: headwind_min_categories applies when SPY+QQQ futures both red or VIX 20-25.

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_multiplier * ATR14). Target = entry + (target_multiplier * ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr.

earnings.note: Tickers with earnings within blackout_days_before OR blackout_days_after of today are excluded.
